claims.claim: 出现突发、持续的胸部疼痛或不适（可为挤压、压迫、烧灼或消化不良样），或疼痛放射至左臂、右臂、颈部、下颌、胃或背部，或胸痛伴出汗、恶心、头晕、气促，可能是心脏病发作，应立即呼叫急救电话。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain - NHS
claims.identifier: NHS Chest pain (page last reviewed 08 August 2023)
claims.supportQuote: Immediate action required: Call 999 if: … you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away – the pain can feel like squeezing or pressure inside your chest, burning or indigestion … you get pain that spreads to your left or right arm, or your neck, jaw, stomach or back … you have chest pain and you feel sweaty, sick, light headed or short of breath … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 面向公众的急救识别；症状清单与门急诊分诊中急性冠脉综合征警示特征一致，可直接用于院外自我判断与就医决策。
claims.uncertainty: 为英国国家医疗服务体系的官方页面，急诊电话为 999；中国场景应本地化为 120，症状清单本身不受影响。

claims.claim: 大多数情况下胸痛并非心脏问题所致。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain - NHS
claims.identifier: NHS Chest pain (page last reviewed 08 August 2023)
claims.supportQuote: In most cases, chest pain is not caused by a heart problem.
claims.applicability: 人群层面的一般性陈述，用于框定胸痛的病因谱，不用于个体排除急性冠脉综合征。
claims.uncertainty: 为一般人群层面表述，未给出分母与金标准，不能据此对个体做排除判断。

claims.claim: 公众不应自行诊断胸痛病因，担忧时应就医评估。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain - NHS
claims.identifier: NHS Chest pain (page last reviewed 08 August 2023)
claims.supportQuote: Do not self-diagnose – see a GP if you're worried.
claims.applicability: 面向公众的就医建议，直接约束院外自我判断行为。
claims.uncertainty: 为一般性建议，未针对具体症状分层。

claims.claim: 在 172 项研究、42 项症状与体征中，没有任何单项临床发现足以单独安全地纳入或排除心肌缺血。
claims.sourceTitle: Does the patient with chest pain have a coronary heart disease? Diagnostic value of single symptoms and signs – a meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: We included 172 studies providing data on the diagnostic value of 42 symptoms and signs. … Not surprisingly, none of these clinical findings showed in isolation a sufficient diagnostic accuracy for safely ruling in or ruling out myocardial ischemia in patients presenting with chest pain.
claims.applicability: 直接针对胸痛患者单项症状学特征的判别效能，人群覆盖急性与慢性胸痛，直接支持院外与门急诊分诊场景。
claims.uncertainty: meta 分析存在显著异质性（多数 I²>80%）与阈值效应，合并似然比的精度有限，按 GRADE 因不一致性降级。

claims.claim: 诊断稳定型冠心病时阳性似然比为冠心病史 3.59、既往心肌梗死史 3.21、典型心绞痛 2.35、糖尿病史 2.16、劳力性疼痛 2.13；诊断心肌梗死时放射至右臂或右肩阳性似然比 4.43。
claims.sourceTitle: Does the patient with chest pain have a coronary heart disease? Diagnostic value of single symptoms and signs – a meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: diagnostically most useful tests were history of CHD (pLR = 3.59), known MI (pLR = 3.21), typical angina (pLR = 2.35), history of diabetes mellitus (pLR = 2.16), exertional pain (pLR = 2.13) … pain radiation to right arm/shoulder (pLR = 4.43)
claims.applicability: 直接给出单项症状学特征的阳性似然比，用于量化症状特征的风险调整幅度。
claims.uncertainty: 似然比按病例定义（稳定型冠心病、心肌梗死、急性冠脉综合征、主要心血管事件）分层而不同，外推需匹配病例定义。

claims.claim: 按压可复现的疼痛（阳性似然比 0.13，各研究区间 0.13–0.41）与呼吸相关痛（阳性似然比 0.20–0.36）是提示心肌缺血可能性降低的体征。
claims.sourceTitle: Does the patient with chest pain have a coronary heart disease? Diagnostic value of single symptoms and signs – a meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: pain reproducible by palpation (pLR = 0.13) for predicting MCE … pain related to breathing might be helpful for ruling out myocardial ischemia, with pLR ranging from 0.20 to 0.36 … pain reproducible by palpation might be helpful for ruling out myocardial ischemia, with pLR ranging from 0.13 to 0.41
claims.applicability: 直接给出常被用作'排除'的体征的阴性似然比，用于判定其能否在缺少客观检查时排除心肌缺血。
claims.uncertainty: 按压可复现痛部分仅能作定性综合，各研究区间较宽；阴性似然比 0.13–0.41 未达到强排除试验所需 ≤0.1。

claims.claim: 按病例定义分层，冠心病患病率区间为：急性冠脉综合征 8.1% 至 79.7%，心肌梗死 3.8% 至 88.0%，稳定型冠心病 16.7% 至 89.9%，主要心血管事件 2.8% 至 34.1%。
claims.sourceTitle: Does the patient with chest pain have a coronary heart disease? Diagnostic value of single symptoms and signs – a meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: The prevalence of CHD with respect to the case definition of CHD ranged from 8.1 to 79.7% (ACS), from 3.8 to 88.0 (MI), from 16.7 to 89.9 (stable CHD), and from 2.8 to 34.1% (MCE).
claims.applicability: 给出症状学特征判读所需的验前概率参考区间，用于推导验后概率。
claims.uncertainty: 区间极宽，反映病例定义与场景差异；验后概率推导对验前概率取值高度敏感。

claims.claim: 病史与体格检查单独无法把急性冠脉综合征风险降到普遍可接受的水平（<1%）；'不典型'症状不能排除急性冠脉综合征，'典型'症状也不能确诊。
claims.sourceTitle: Utility of the History and Physical Examination in the Detection of Acute Coronary Syndromes in Emergency Department Patients
claims.supportQuote: The history and physical alone are unable to reduce a patient’s risk of ACS to a generally acceptable level (<1%). … our review of the evidence clearly demonstrates that “atypical” symptoms cannot rule out ACS, while “typical” symptoms cannot rule it in.
claims.applicability: 直接针对急诊未分化胸痛患者，直接回答'症状学特征能否替代客观检查'这一核心问题。
claims.uncertainty: 为叙述性综述的综合判断，其下各前瞻性队列的个体估计存在差异。

claims.claim: Goodacre 等前瞻性研究（893 例）显示放射至肩部（OR 5.7）、放射至双臂（OR 4.9）、劳力加重（OR 3.3）与急性心肌梗死相关，胸壁压痛降低急性心肌梗死可能性（OR 0.2）。
claims.sourceTitle: Utility of the History and Physical Examination in the Detection of Acute Coronary Syndromes in Emergency Department Patients
claims.supportQuote: Goodacre et al. prospectively enrolled 893 patients presenting with chest pain … AMI was most closely associated with chest pain that radiated to the shoulder (odds ratio [OR]=5.7, 95% confidence interval [CI] [1.5–21.4], p=0.009), radiated to both arms (OR=4.9, 95% CI [1.3–19.4], p=0.02), or was exacerbated with exertion (OR=3.3, 95% CI [1.3–8.4], p=0.014) … the presence of chest wall tenderness decreased the likelihood of AMI (OR=0.2, 95% CI [0.05–0.97], p=0.045).
claims.applicability: 急诊前瞻性队列，直接给出症状学特征的关联强度与方向。
claims.uncertainty: 单中心前瞻性队列，置信区间较宽（如肩部放射 OR 的 95%CI 为 1.5–21.4）。

claims.claim: Chun 与 McGee 系统评价：右臂或肩痛 LR+ 4.7、出汗 LR+ 2.9；正常心电图 LR+ 0.2、胸壁压痛可复现 LR+ 0.3、胸膜炎性痛 LR+ 0.2、针刺样痛 LR+ 0.3、体位性痛 LR+ 0.3。
claims.sourceTitle: Utility of the History and Physical Examination in the Detection of Acute Coronary Syndromes in Emergency Department Patients
claims.supportQuote: the features that best predicted AMI were right arm or shoulder pain (LR+=4.7, 95% CI: 1.9–12), an S3 gallop (LR+=3.2, 95% CI [1.6–6.5]), and either a history (LR+=2.1, 95% CI [1.8–2.5]) or a finding of diaphoresis (LR+=2.9, 95% CI [1.3–6.6]) … The factors that decreased the likelihood of AMI were a normal ECG (LR+=0.2; 95% CI [0.1–0.3]) and reproducible chest wall tenderness (LR+=0.3; 95% CI [0.2–0.4]). Chest pain that was pleuritic (LR+=0.2; 95% CI [0.2–0.3]), sharp (LR = 0.3; 95% CI [0.2–0.5]), or positional (LR = 0.3; 95% CI [0.2–0.5]) also lowered the likelihood of AMI.
claims.applicability: 系统评价汇总的单项特征似然比，含正常心电图与针刺样、胸膜炎性、体位性痛等'非心源性'特征的阴性似然比。
claims.uncertainty: 引用的原始系统评价（Chun & McGee）检索截止于 2003 年前后，部分特征为转述。

claims.claim: Bruyninckx 等 meta 分析报告胸壁压痛 LR+ 0.17（0.11–0.28）、右臂/肩痛 LR+ 3.78（选定人群）与 3.80（未分化人群）。
claims.sourceTitle: Utility of the History and Physical Examination in the Detection of Acute Coronary Syndromes in Emergency Department Patients
claims.supportQuote: Pain in the right arm or shoulder was suggestive of ACS in both selected (LR+=3.78, 95% CI [2.17–6.60]) and undifferentiated patients (LR+=3.80, 95% CI [1.12–12.91]). … The feature most closely associated with an alternative diagnosis was chest wall tenderness (LR+=0.17, 95% CI [0.11–0.28]).
claims.applicability: 独立 meta 分析对胸壁压痛这一'非心源性'特征的阴性似然比估计，与 CLM-006 互证。
claims.uncertainty: 胸壁压痛 LR+ 0.17 已接近强排除界值 0.1，但仍未达到。

claims.claim: Body 等前瞻性研究（804 例）报告急诊观察到出汗 LR+ 6.39、呕吐 LR+ 3.09、放射至双臂 LR+ 2.58 与急性心肌梗死相关。
claims.sourceTitle: Utility of the History and Physical Examination in the Detection of Acute Coronary Syndromes in Emergency Department Patients
claims.supportQuote: Body and colleagues examined 804 patients who sought treatment in a university-affiliated ED … The features of the HPI and physical exam that were most associated with AMI were observed diaphoresis in the ED (LR+=6.39, 95% CI [4.38–9.33]), reported vomiting (LR+=3.09, 95% CI [1.89–5.05]), and pain radiation to both arms/shoulders (LR+=2.58, 95% CI [1.53–4.34])
claims.applicability: 急诊前瞻性队列，给出急性期最强的阳性症状似然比。
claims.uncertainty: 出汗虽 LR+ 最高，但为非罕见体征，单中心数据。

claims.claim: 胸痛约占急诊就诊的 6%。
claims.sourceTitle: Utility of the History and Physical Examination in the Detection of Acute Coronary Syndromes in Emergency Department Patients
claims.supportQuote: Chest pain accounts for approximately 6% of all emergency department (ED) visits
claims.applicability: 框定胸痛在急诊的疾病负担。
claims.uncertainty: 该综述正文另有 5.4% 的表述，两者为不同统计口径，属近似值。

claims.claim: 即便病史与心电图均'良性'，急性冠脉综合征的验后概率仍约为 6%，多数临床医生认为这一概率过高。
claims.sourceTitle: Utility of the History and Physical Examination in the Detection of Acute Coronary Syndromes in Emergency Department Patients
claims.supportQuote: Adding in our patient’s normal ECG (LR+ = 0.2) does lower his risk, and our new post-test probability of disease is still 0.06. … most physicians would feel that a 6% probability of ACS is too high.
claims.applicability: 直接回答'心电图正常即可排除'这一说法，量化正常心电图后的残余风险。
claims.uncertainty: 为单一病例推演而非队列估计，取决于验前概率取值。

claims.sourceTitle: Performance of the 0-Hour/1-Hour Algorithm for Diagnosing Myocardial Infarction in Patients With Chest Pain in the Emergency Department — A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis —
claims.supportQuote: A meta-analysis of the diagnostic accuracy of the 0/1-h algorithm using hs-cTnI including 6 observational databases (n=7,235 patients in total) … showed a pooled sensitivity of 99.3% (95% CI 98.5–99.7%) and a specificity of 90.1% (95% CI 80.7–95.2%).
claims.applicability: 直接给出高敏肌钙蛋白 0/1 小时算法对心肌梗死的判别效能，是客观检查排除节点的核心证据。
claims.uncertainty: 系统评价主要纳入西方国家队列，以 QUADAS-2 评价偏倚风险，对亚洲人群的适用性需本土验证。

claims.sourceTitle: Performance of the 0-Hour/1-Hour Algorithm for Diagnosing Myocardial Infarction in Patients With Chest Pain in the Emergency Department — A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis —
claims.supportQuote: including 10 observational databases (n=9,188 patients in total) … showed that the pooled sensitivity and specificity of the ESC 0/1-h algorithm using hs-cTnT were 99.3% (95% CI 96.9–99.9%) and 91.7% (95% CI 83.5–96.1%), respectively. When the prevalence was assumed to be 10% (assuming a maximum of false positives), the false positive rate was 75 per 1,000 patients (95% CI 35–148) and, when the prevalence was assumed to be 30% (assuming a maximum of false negatives), the false negative rate was 2 per 1,000 patients (95% CI 0–9
claims.applicability: 给出连续高敏肌钙蛋白算法的灵敏度与假阴性率，用于与症状学特征、单项检查的排除效能对比。
claims.uncertainty: 假阴性率为患病率假设下的推算值，非直接观察。

claims.claim: EDACS-ADP 系统评价（12 项研究、14 290 例）合并灵敏度 0.97（0.95–0.99）、特异度 0.58（0.53–0.63）、阴性似然比 0.04（0.02–0.09）；52.74% 的患者被判定为低危，低危组 30 天主要心血管事件发生率为 0.89%。
claims.sourceTitle: A systematic review of the applicability of emergency department assessment of chest pain score-accelerated diagnostic protocol for risk stratification of patients with chest pain
claims.supportQuote: Twelve studies comprising 14 290 patients were identified. … EDACS‐ADP showed a combined sensitivity of 0.97 (95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.95−0.99); specificity, 0.58 (0.53−0.63); positive DLR, 2.34 (2.08−2.63); negative DLR, 0.04 (0.02−0.09) … 7537 (52.74%) of the pooled patient group were classified as low risk, while 67 (0.89%) patients in the low‐risk group suffered from MACE within 30‐days
claims.applicability: 直接给出 EDACS-ADP 复合评分的判别效能与其'低危'对应的残余风险。
claims.uncertainty: 研究间异质性高（I²>75%），外部队列结果不稳定，敏感性按发表年份与样本量分层而不同。

claims.claim: 低危患者主要心血管事件发生率 >1% 对近半数医生不可接受，>2% 对多数医生不可接受。
claims.sourceTitle: A systematic review of the applicability of emergency department assessment of chest pain score-accelerated diagnostic protocol for risk stratification of patients with chest pain
claims.supportQuote: A study has shown that a MACE incidence >1% among low‐risk patients was unacceptable to nearly half of the physicians, whereas an incidence >2% was unacceptable to most physicians.
claims.applicability: 给出'可接受残余风险'的临床阈值，是判定症状学特征能否独立完成排除的参照标准。
claims.uncertainty: 为临床医生的主观接受度调查，非共识性硬阈值。

claims.claim: HEART 评分（≤3 为低危）AUC 0.925、灵敏度 97.1%、阴性预测值 98.18%；TIMI AUC 0.868；GRACE AUC 0.815；EDACS-ADP AUC 0.803（274 例，6 周主要心血管事件率 24.8%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Improving chest pain risk assessment: validation of HEART, TIMI, GRACE, EDACS-ADP, and HET for MACE prediction in the emergency department
claims.supportQuote: A total of 274 patients were finally included. Among them 68 (24.8%) met the MACE at presentation or within 6 weeks. The HEART score demonstrated the highest AUC: 0.925 and sensitivity: 97.1%; NPV: 98.18% at cut-off ≤ 3 … TIMI also performed well in identifying very low-risk patients (AUC: 0.868; sensitivity: 98.5%, NPV: 98.17%, though with limited specificity (26.7%). GRACE and EDACS-ADP showed moderate predictive ability, with AUCs of 0.815 and 0.803, respectively.
claims.applicability: 同一队列内 HEART、TIMI、GRACE、EDACS-ADP 的头对头比较，直接回答各复合评分的相对判别效能。
claims.uncertainty: 单中心回顾性队列（274 例），事件率高（24.8%），外推受样本与场景限制。

claims.claim: 在线症状自查工具的诊断准确率总体低且平均低于全科医生；系统评价纳入的 14 项研究全部至少有一个偏倚风险不明确领域，6/14（43%）为高偏倚风险。
claims.sourceTitle: Triage and Diagnostic Accuracy of Online Symptom Checkers: Systematic Review
claims.supportQuote: the diagnostic accuracy was deemed to be low overall and, on average, lower than that of general practitioners (GPs) when compared … all studies had at least 1 area with unclear risk of bias, and 6 (43%) of the 14 studies had a high risk of bias
claims.applicability: 直接针对面向公众的自我鉴别工具，回答其质量与证据强度。
claims.uncertainty: 纳入研究均来自高收入国家，以 QUADAS-2 评价，异质性高、无统一金标准。

claims.claim: 在线症状自查工具存在低估病情：Yu 等报告 Drugs.com 与 FamilyDoctor 分别低估 24% 与 45% 的病例，Chan 等估计遵循建议可减少 55% 的就诊但会导致 2% 至 3% 的病例延迟就医。
claims.sourceTitle: Triage and Diagnostic Accuracy of Online Symptom Checkers: Systematic Review
claims.supportQuote: Yu et al [ 27 ] found that Drugs.com and FamilyDoctor undertriaged 24% (95% CI 16%-34%) and 45% (95% CI 35%-55%) of the cases, respectively. Chan et al [ 25 ] estimated that compliance with the triage recommendations in their cohort could have reduced hospital visits by 55% but would also cause potential harm from delayed care in 2% to 3% of the cases.
claims.applicability: 给出自我鉴别工具低估病情、可能漏掉紧急病例的直接数据。
claims.uncertainty: 为各原始研究的转述，分诊准确率的定义与金标准在各项研究间不一致。

claims.claim: 多数研究（5/9，56%）观察到在线症状自查工具存在低估病情，另有 5 项研究观察到过度分级（over-triage）倾向。
claims.sourceTitle: Triage and Diagnostic Accuracy of Online Symptom Checkers: Systematic Review
claims.supportQuote: Of these 9 studies, 5 (56%) found that OSCs tend to overtriage (ie, be risk averse) … However, most of the studies (5/9, 56%) observed that undertriage did occur.
claims.applicability: 刻画自我鉴别工具在过度分级与低估之间的双向偏倚。
claims.uncertainty: 各研究对过度分级与低估的定义与阈值不一致。

claims.claim: 胸痛的常见非心源性病因包括烧心或消化不良、胸壁扭伤或劳损、焦虑抑郁或惊恐发作、肺部感染或胸膜炎，以及带状疱疹；心源性病因主要为心包炎与心绞痛或心肌梗死。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain - NHS
claims.identifier: NHS Chest pain (page last reviewed 08 August 2023)
claims.supportQuote: Common causes of chest pain … Heartburn or indigestion … Chest sprain or strain … Anxiety , depression or panic attack … Chest infection, pneumonia or pleurisy … Shingles … pericarditis – which usually causes a sudden, sharp, stabbing pain that gets worse when you breathe deeply or lie down … angina or a heart attack – which have similar symptoms but a heart attack is life-threatening
claims.applicability: 给出胸痛病因谱的心源性与非心源性分类，用于框定构成比讨论；为一般人群层面的定性分类，不用于个体排除判断。
claims.uncertainty: 为官方患者教育页面的定性分类，未给出各病因的比例与金标准，仅用于框定病因谱。

claims.claim: 在 10% 验前概率下，即便最强的阴性特征（按压可复现痛，LR(−) 0.13）也只能把急性冠脉综合征验后概率降到约 1.4%，针刺样痛（LR(−) 0.3）降到约 3.2%，均高于 1% 阈值。
claims.method: 以验后比数公式 post-test odds = pretest odds × LR(−) 计算，pretest odds = p/(1−p)。取急诊未分化胸痛中急性冠脉综合征验前概率 p = 0.10（CLM-007 中 ACS 患病率 8.1% 的下端取值），pretest odds = 0.10/0.90 ≈ 0.111。按压可复现痛的阴性似然比取 CLM-006 的区间 0.41 与 0.13：odds = 0.111×0.41 ≈ 0.0456，验后概率 = 0.0456/(1+0.0456) ≈ 4.4%；odds = 0.111×0.13 ≈ 0.0144，验后概率 ≈ 1.4%。针刺样痛取 CLM-010 的 LR(−) = 0.3：odds = 0.111×0.3 ≈ 0.0333，验后概率 ≈ 3.2%。三者均高于 CLM-018 给出的 1% 阈值。
claims.assumptions: 验前概率取 10% 为急诊场景的低值假设；各症状学特征之间视为近似独立；似然比采用系统评价合并值或区间边界，未进一步校正研究间异质性。
claims.sensitivity: 若验前概率降至 5%（近似社区/基层场景），pretest odds = 0.05/0.95 ≈ 0.0526，按压可复现痛 LR(−)=0.13 时 odds ≈ 0.0068、验后概率 ≈ 0.68%，才降至 1% 以下；而针刺样痛 LR(−)=0.3 时 odds ≈ 0.0158、验后概率 ≈ 1.55%，仍高于 1%。若验前概率升至 20%，按压可复现痛 LR(−)=0.13 时验后概率 ≈ 3.2%。结果对验前概率取值高度敏感，验前概率越高，即便最强阴性特征也不能把风险压到可接受水平以下。
claims.applicability: 仅用于量化症状学特征在缺少客观检查时的排除能力边界，不用于临床实践建议。
claims.uncertainty: 为基于合并似然比与假设验前概率的推算值，非直接观察；各特征独立性与似然比的区间取值未经验证。
